method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces three core secrets for pirouettes: preparation, balance, and spotting. For each tip, she breaks down common mistakes and explains how to align the body and engage muscles correctly to achieve a stable turn.

practices.what: Focus on tip 1: the preparation, covering weight placement and the power of the toe for the first quarter turn.
Focus on tip 2: staying on balance by keeping shoulders and hips aligned and using the back muscles.
Focus on tip 3: spotting correctly for single or multiple turns without losing eye focus or rushing.

beliefs.belief: These sensations are only discovered if you take the time to practice and discover them consistently.

struggles.theme: Falling backwards or falling out of the pirouette
Stamina and lack of fuel in ankles and feet during center work
Turning better to one side than the other

clicked.theme: Spotting technique and whipping the head around after the first quarter
Following the tips led to the most stable spin ever
Hand tip and slight lifting of the other side helped immensely

requests.theme: More detail on how the back helps turns
Content with male ballet dancers at a high level

meant.theme: Started ballet later in life (adult recreational / beginner) and found the videos very helpful

method.limits: The instructor sits and talks through the concepts while demonstration clips play in split screen or full screen, so real-time follow-along practice with the instructor moving live is absent.
